_note: Written before any model fitting or tuning (checkpoint 1). Day numbers refer to M5 d_<n>. An origin T means history d_1..d_T is known and forecasts cover d_(T+1)..d_(T+28). All origins are Sundays (T mod 7 == 2).

holdout.rule: Untouched until config/frozen_choices.json exists. Weekly origins inside the holdout use holdout actuals only as already-observed history, never for choices.

priority_calibration_origins.purpose: fix large-error event threshold, interval width multiplier, signal normalisation checks

priority_validation_origins.purpose: choose priority-score weights and compare rules; freeze before holdout

lightgbm_training.rule: training row (t,h) used at origin T only if t+h <= T
